# Introduction

**vayuayan** (वायुअयन) is an R package for fetching and analyzing air quality data from WUSTL ACAG satellite PM2.5 (global) and CPCB & OAQ monitoring networks (India). The name combines two Sanskrit words:

- **Vayu** (वायु): Wind, air
- **Ayan** (अयन): Path, journey, movement

Together, "Vayuayan" means "the path of wind."

## Installation

```{r install, eval=FALSE}
# Install from GitHub
devtools::install_github("saketlab/vayuayanR")
```

## Data sources

The package provides access to:

1. **WUSTL ACAG**: Washington University satellite PM2.5 data
   - Global coverage at ~1 km resolution
   - Monthly and annual data (1998-2022)

2. **CPCB**: Central Pollution Control Board monitoring network (India)
   - Historical and real-time AQI data
   - Station-level and city-level data

3. **OAQ**: Open Air Quality low-cost sensor networks (India)
   - Multiple providers including Airnet
   - Daily, monthly, and annual data

## Quick start

```{r quickstart}
library(vayuayan)

vayuayan_welcome()
```

# Historical AQI data

The `cpcb_` functions provide access to historical air quality data from the Central Pollution Control Board.

## Exploring available data

```{r historical_explore, eval = CPCB_OK}
states <- cpcb_get_state_list()
head(states)

cities <- cpcb_get_city_list("Maharashtra")
head(cities)

stations <- cpcb_get_station_list("Mumbai")
head(stations)
```

### Adding coordinates to stations

```{r add_coords, eval = CPCB_OK}
# Primary source: CPCB live feed (same as Python vayuayan package)
# Fallback: Nominatim geocoding for stations temporarily absent from live feed
delhi_station_list <- cpcb_get_station_list("Delhi")
delhi_station_list <- cpcb_add_coords(delhi_station_list)
```

## Downloading historical data

### City-level data

```{r city_data, eval = CPCB_OK}
cpcb_download_city_data(
  city          = "Mumbai",
  year          = 2024,
  save_location = "mumbai_aqi_2024.csv"
)
```

### Station-level data

```{r station_data, eval = CPCB_OK}
cpcb_download_station_data(
  station_id    = "site_5964",
  year          = 2024,
  save_location = "station_data_2024.csv"
)
```

# Live AQI monitoring

The `cpcb_` live functions enable real-time air quality monitoring.

## Location-based monitoring

```{r live_location, eval = CPCB_OK}
location <- cpcb_get_system_location()
print(location)

nearest <- cpcb_get_nearest_station()
cat("Nearest Station:", nearest$station_name)
cat("Distance:", round(nearest$distance_km, 2), "km")
```

## Getting live AQI data

```{r live_aqi, eval = CPCB_OK}
aqi_data <- cpcb_get_live_aqi_data()

if (!is.null(aqi_data$metrics) && is.data.frame(aqi_data$metrics)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(aqi_data$metrics))) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "%s: Avg=%s, Min=%s, Max=%s\n",
      aqi_data$metrics$name[i],
      aqi_data$metrics$avg[i],
      aqi_data$metrics$min[i],
      aqi_data$metrics$max[i]
    ))
  }
}

mumbai_coords <- c(19.0760, 72.8777)
aqi_data <- cpcb_get_live_aqi_data(coords = mumbai_coords)

aqi_data <- cpcb_get_live_aqi_data(
  station_id = "site_5964",
  date       = "2024-02-25",
  hour       = 10
)
```

# Data analysis with tidyverse

The package integrates seamlessly with tidyverse workflows.

## Station data analysis

```{r tidyverse_analysis, eval = CPCB_OK}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

all_stations <- cpcb_get_all_india()

df <- stations_to_dataframe(all_stations)

state_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(state_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_stations = n(),
    live_stations = sum(live),
    offline_stations = sum(!live),
    avg_aqi = mean(avg_aqi, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(live_stations))

print(head(state_summary, 10))
```

## AQI distribution analysis

```{r aqi_distribution, eval = CPCB_OK}
df_with_categories <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_aqi)) %>%
  mutate(aqi_category = get_aqi_categories(avg_aqi))

category_dist <- df_with_categories %>%
  count(aqi_category) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

print(category_dist)

ggplot(df_with_categories, aes(x = avg_aqi, fill = aqi_category)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Good"         = "green",
      "Satisfactory" = "lightgreen",
      "Moderate"     = "yellow",
      "Poor"         = "orange",
      "Very Poor"    = "red",
      "Severe"       = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of AQI Values Across India",
    x     = "AQI",
    y     = "Number of Stations",
    fill  = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# PM2.5 satellite data

The `pm25_` functions process satellite-based PM2.5 data from WUSTL ACAG.
These examples read a local WUSTL V5GL04 monthly file via the `nc_file`
argument, which skips the download step.

```{r pm25_setup}
# Local WUSTL V5GL04 monthly PM2.5 file (November 2022)
pm25_nc <- paste0(
  "/NAS/climatehealth/WUSTL_PM2.5/V5GL04/Global/Monthly/",
  "V5GL04.HybridPM25.Global.202211-202211.nc"
)
```

## Basic usage

```{r pm25_basic}
# PM2.5 statistics for a region (GeoJSON file or URL + a local NetCDF)
delhi_stats <- pm25_get_stats(
  geojson_file = "https://geo.bharatviz.org/geojsons/cities/delhi.geojson",
  nc_file      = pm25_nc
)

print(delhi_stats)
```

## Grouped analysis

```{r pm25_grouped}
# PM2.5 grouped by state
state_stats <- pm25_get_stats(
  geojson_file = "https://geo.bharatviz.org/geojsons/districts/India_LGD_districts.geojson",
  nc_file      = pm25_nc,
  group_by     = "state_name"
)

print(head(state_stats))

# Group by multiple columns
district_stats <- pm25_get_stats(
  geojson_file = "https://geo.bharatviz.org/geojsons/districts/India_LGD_districts.geojson",
  nc_file      = pm25_nc,
  group_by     = "state_name,district_name"
)

print(head(district_stats))
```

## Cache management

When `pm25_get_stats()` downloads data itself (no `nc_file`), the NetCDF
files are cached. These helpers inspect and manage that cache.

```{r pm25_cache}
pm25_list_cached_files()
```

# Geospatial analysis

## Mapping monitoring stations

```{r geospatial}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

all_stations <- tryCatch(
  cpcb_get_all_india(),
  error = function(e) {
    message("CPCB API unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)

if (!is.null(all_stations)) {
  df <- stations_to_dataframe(all_stations)

  live_stations <- df %>%
    filter(live == TRUE, !is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude)) %>%
    mutate(aqi_category = get_aqi_categories(avg_aqi))

  stations_sf <- st_as_sf(
    live_stations,
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs    = 4326
  )

  print(ggplot(stations_sf) +
    geom_sf(aes(color = aqi_category), size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Good"         = "green",
        "Satisfactory" = "lightgreen",
        "Moderate"     = "yellow",
        "Poor"         = "orange",
        "Very Poor"    = "red",
        "Severe"       = "darkred"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = "Live Air Quality Monitoring Stations in India",
      subtitle = paste("Total stations:", nrow(stations_sf)),
      color    = "AQI Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal())
} else {
  message("Skipping station map — CPCB API not reachable at build time.")
}
```

## Spatial filtering

```{r spatial_filtering}
if (exists("stations_sf")) {
  mh_bbox <- st_bbox(
    c(xmin = 72.5, ymin = 15.5, xmax = 80.5, ymax = 22.5),
    crs = 4326
  )
  mh_stations <- st_crop(stations_sf, mh_bbox)
  cat("Stations in Maharashtra region:", nrow(mh_stations))
} else {
  message("Skipping spatial filtering — station data not available.")
}
```

# Utility functions

## Station name cleaning

```{r clean_names}
clean_station_name("Dr. Karni Singh Shooting Range, Delhi - DPCC")
# Output: "Dr_Karni_Singh_Shooting_Range_Delhi_DPCC"

clean_station_name("ITO, Delhi - DPCC")
# Output: "ITO_Delhi_DPCC"
```

## Distance calculations

```{r distance}
mumbai <- c(19.0760, 72.8777)
delhi <- c(28.7041, 77.1025)

distance <- haversine_distance(
  mumbai[1], mumbai[2],
  delhi[1],  delhi[2]
)

cat("Distance from Mumbai to Delhi:", round(distance), "km")
```

## Comprehensive analysis

```{r comprehensive, eval = CPCB_OK}
all_stations <- cpcb_get_all_india()
analysis <- analyze_station_data(all_stations)

str(analysis)
```

# Best practices

## Error handling

```{r error_handling, eval = CPCB_OK}
# Always use tryCatch for API calls
tryCatch(
  {
    aqi_data <- cpcb_get_live_aqi_data()
    print(aqi_data$metrics)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("Error fetching data: ", e$message)
  }
)
```

## Caching strategy

```{r caching}
# Check cache before downloading
cached_files <- pm25_list_cached_files("~/.vayuayan_cache")

# Clear old cache periodically
if (length(cached_files) > 10) {
  pm25_clear_cache("~/.vayuayan_cache")
}
```

## Data validation

```{r validation, eval = CPCB_OK}
df <- stations_to_dataframe(all_stations)

stations_no_coords <- df %>%
  filter(is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude))

if (nrow(stations_no_coords) > 0) {
  warning(sprintf(
    "%d stations missing coordinates",
    nrow(stations_no_coords)
  ))
}

df %>%
  filter(avg_aqi < 0 | avg_aqi > 500) %>%
  nrow() -> invalid_aqi

if (invalid_aqi > 0) {
  warning(sprintf("%d stations with invalid AQI", invalid_aqi))
}
```
